scope: Primitive two-state growing-gap Casoratian/continuant admission for the overlap-normalized beta high-singleton problem

claims.label: PROVED
claims.claim: The transfer rows satisfy q_(n+d)=P_d(n)q_(n+1)+P_(d-1)(n+1)q_n and det(r_e,r_d)=(-1)^d P_(e-d)(n+d).
claims.scope_limit: the admissible primitive class is one 2x2 transition-row minor with a possibly growing gap

claims.label: PROVED
claims.claim: For every divisor p^s of q_n, p^s divides the scalar Casoratian C_h(n) iff it divides P_h(n) iff it divides q_(n+h).
claims.scope_limit: this is a level-transport equivalence, not an upper bound for v_p(q_n)

claims.label: PROVED
claims.claim: If a=v_p(q_n) and b=v_p(P_h(n))<a, then v_p(C_h(n))=b exactly.
claims.scope_limit: when b>=a the theorem asserts divisibility to level a, not an exact value above a

claims.label: PROVED
claims.claim: The primitive residual coefficient satisfies (4n+6)^(h-1)<=P_h(n)<=[4(n+h)]^(h-1); hence log P_h(n)=O(n) exactly on the scale h=O(n/log n).
claims.evidence: report Section 4, positivity and one-step continuant bounds
claims.scope_limit: height refers to the primitive gap coefficient, the most optimistic residual after the boundary p-unit is removed

claims.label: PROVED_SCOPED_NO_GO
claims.claim: A primitive growing Casoratian cannot reach a level supported only at one index inside a window containing both endpoints.
claims.scope_limit: a short same-depth return outside the chosen window is not excluded

claims.label: PROVED_SCOPED_HEIGHT_NO_GO
claims.claim: The universal odd-modulus construction h=M reaches every M|q_n but costs log P_M(n)>=(M-1)log(4n+6); for an Item265 high level p^a>N this is at least N log(4N+6).
claims.evidence: archived odd-modulus anti-period plus report Section 5
claims.scope_limit: no minimal-period claim is made; a shorter return is a separate open arithmetic input

claims.label: PROVED_DEOVERLAP
claims.claim: For qbar_(m,n)=q_n/gcd(q_n,D_m), qbar divides C_h(n) iff it divides P_h(n) iff it divides q_(n+h), primewise at every surviving exponent.
claims.scope_limit: this reproduces the normalized beta level and creates no factor independent of the Item265 two-copy reservoir

claims.label: EXACT_FINITE_ONLY
claims.claim: The deterministic checker replays polynomial, transfer, gcd, minor, Casoratian, valuation, height, anti-period, and de-overlap identities on bounded exact ranges.
claims.scope_limit: no exceptional-singleton search or asymptotic extrapolation is performed

claims.label: OPEN_NOT_PROVED
claims.claim: Growing products or sums, arbitrary growing Hankel determinants, a short-return theorem, and the uniform prime-power-height theorem remain open.
claims.scope_limit: Item276 is not a general no-go for every growing auxiliary

claims.label: PROVED_BOOKING_DECISION
claims.claim: The positive-linear capacity admission test fails; no new Route-1 rate or beta capacity reduction is booked.
claims.scope_limit: the Item265 high-singleton ceiling and two-copy overlap normalization remain unchanged
